# The consumers a release of swarm-core is checked against before it ships
# (swarm-routing/.github#482): release.yml passes this file as
# reusable-release.yml's `downstream-consumers`, and a dry run builds and
# tests each line on ns3-dev latest-debug with this repository's checkout as
# the `swarm-adapter-ns3` line, the repository's name (reusable-release.yml's
# `downstream-self` default; swarm-routing/.github tools/downstream/downstream.sh,
# whose header documents the columns). Report-only: it says which consumer a
# release would break, the bump goes on regardless.
#
#   name | owner/repo@ref | ns-3 | modules | suites | stage | run
#
# swarm-core itself, then each protocol's ns-3 module on it (as
# sim-containers' canary builds them; a protocol with no ns3/ yet is skipped).
# Since #231 the module has no core/: swarm-core's primitives come from the
# swarm-routing/swarm-core release swarm-core.lock names, through the
# module's PUBLIC dependency (its include directory reaches every module
# that links ${libswarm-core}). A consumer that still looks for
# contrib/swarm-core/core fails here until it moves to that dependency.
swarm-adapter-ns3 | swarm-routing/swarm-adapter-ns3@main | 3.42+ | swarm-core=swarm-adapter-ns3 | | |
ARA | swarm-routing/ARA@main | 3.42+ | swarm-core=swarm-adapter-ns3 ara=ARA/ns3 | | |
BeeAdHoc | swarm-routing/BeeAdHoc@main | 3.42+ | swarm-core=swarm-adapter-ns3 beeadhoc=BeeAdHoc/ns3 | | |
Termite | swarm-routing/Termite@main | 3.42+ | swarm-core=swarm-adapter-ns3 termite=Termite/ns3 | | |
HOPNET | swarm-routing/HOPNET@main | 3.42+ | swarm-core=swarm-adapter-ns3 hopnet=HOPNET/ns3 | | |
# AntHocNet: its install stages its arm modules and the routing-bench
# release its ns3-tools.lock names; swarm-core is this checkout itself, not
# the release its swarm-core.lock names. Its SWARM_CORE_DIR took this
# checkout's core/, which is gone (#231), so the stage installs AntHocNet's
# own swarm-core release beside it, unused: the build takes this checkout.
AntHocNet | swarm-routing/AntHocNet@main | 3.36+ | swarm-core=swarm-adapter-ns3 routing-bench=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/routing-bench oracle=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/oracle aomdv=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/aomdv gpsr=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/gpsr adaptive=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/adaptive anthocnet=AntHocNet/.stage/contrib/anthocnet | anthocnet oracle adaptive | mkdir -p .stage/contrib && touch .stage/CMakeLists.txt && make -s install-ns3 NS3DIR="$PWD/.stage" | cd /opt/ns-3 && ./ns3 run --no-build anthocnet-example
